mapper.select: SELECT ID, SensorName, GroupID, LimitNotice, LimitAttention, LimitWarning, LimitValueLaw, SensorUse, SensorUnit, SensorRemark,LimitType, LimitNoticeBegin, LimitNoticeEnd, LimitAttentionBegin, LimitAttentionEnd, LimitWarningBegin, LimitWarningEnd, LimitValueLawBegin, LimitValueLawEnd FROM SensorCode WHERE SensorUse = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SensorCode (ID, SensorName, GroupID, LimitNotice, LimitAttention, LimitWarning, LimitValueLaw, SensorUse, LimitType , LimitNoticeBegin, LimitNoticeEnd, LimitAttentionBegin, LimitAttentionEnd, LimitWarningBegin, LimitWarningEnd, LimitValueLawBegin, LimitValueLawEnd, SensorUnit, SensorRemark ) VALUES ( #{ID}, #{Name}, #{GroupID},#{LimitNotice}, #{LimitAttention},#{LimitWarning},#{LimitValueLaw}, 1, #{LimitType}, #{LimitNoticeBegin},#{LimitNoticeEnd}, #{LimitAttentionBegin}, #{LimitAttentionEnd}, #{LimitWarningBegin}, #{LimitWarningEnd}, #{LimitValueLawBegin}, #{LimitValueLawEnd}, #{Unit}, #{Remark} )
